description: Foundation: scaffold the Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui app at frontend/, then build the typed API/services layer, the auth/session + role-guard infrastructure, and the reusable UI components + React Query data/mutation hooks. This feature establishes everything the role areas depend on and must leave the tree building. It depends on nothing else and must come first.
steps: Scaffold a Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind project in c:/Users/Acer/Documents/ANTIGRAV/bengkel-motor-6/frontend using pnpm (create-next-app with --app --ts --tailwind --src-dir --eslint). Initialize shadcn/ui (components.json) and add primitives used across the app (button, input, form, label, select, dialog, table, card, badge, sonner/toast, dropdown-menu, skeleton, tabs). Add deps: react-hook-form, @hookform/resolvers, zod, @tanstack/react-query, axios, lucide-react. Add dev deps vitest + @testing-library/react + jsdom and a 'test' script.

Create frontend/.env.local and frontend/.env.example both containing NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/api. Create frontend/.gitignore that ignores node_modules/, .next/, out/, and .env* while keeping !.env.example. Confirm the root .gitignore already covers .env.local.

Create frontend/src/types/api.ts: the ApiEnvelope<T> and ApiError shapes ({success,message,data?,pagination?,errors:[{field,location,message}]}), plus domain types User, Booking (with partsUsed[], statusHistory[], serviceFee, partsTotalCost, grandTotal, pickedUpAt, mechanicId populated shape), Part (incl. isLowStock), Service, DashboardReport, RevenueReport. Define ServiceStatus union 'Antre'|'Diperiksa'|'Dikerjakan'|'Selesai'|'Diambil'|'Dibatalkan' and an ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS map mirroring backend/src/constants/index.ts exactly. Define UserRole union.

Create frontend/src/lib/api-client.ts: an axios instance with baseURL from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL. Request interceptor injects Authorization: Bearer <token> from the session store. Response interceptor returns response.data and, on {success:false} or non-2xx, throws a typed error exposing message and field errors; a 401 clears the session. Add a helper to fetch binary (PDF) with the auth header for invoice download.

Create frontend/src/services/{auth,bookings,users,parts,services,reports}.ts with one typed function per documented endpoint from API_DOCUMENTATION.md (auth: register, login, me, updateMe, changePassword; bookings: createOnline, createWalkIn, list(query), getById, assign, updateStatus, addPart, removePart, invoicePdfBlob; users: createStaff, mechanics, list(query), getById, toggleStatus; parts: list, lowStock, getById, create, update; services: list, getById, create, update, delete; reports: dashboard, revenue(query)). No React here - pure functions calling api-client.

Create the auth/session layer: frontend/src/lib/auth-context.tsx (React context holding token+user, persisted to localStorage, with login/logout and hydrate-from-/auth/me), frontend/src/hooks/use-auth.ts, and a role->home map (pelanggan->/pelanggan, kasir & admin->/staff, mekanik->/mekanik, pemilik & admin->/owner; pick admin default home and expose helper for allowed areas). Create frontend/src/components/guards/role-guard.tsx that redirects unauthenticated users to /login and wrong-role users to their home.

Wrap the app in frontend/src/app/layout.tsx with the QueryClientProvider, AuthProvider, and the shadcn Toaster (sonner). Add a global Rupiah/date formatter util in frontend/src/lib/format.ts (Intl id-ID, Asia/Jakarta).

Create reusable presentational components in frontend/src/components/ (StatusBadge, StatusStepper for the 5-stage flow + Dibatalkan, DataTable, PageHeader, StatCard, EmptyState, LoadingState/skeleton, ErrorState, ConfirmDialog, a FormField wrapper around react-hook-form). Keep them presentation-only (props in, no data fetching).

Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/ (useBookings, useBooking, useParts, useServices, useMechanics, useUsers, useDashboard, useRevenue) and mutation hooks (useLogin, useRegister, useCreateBooking, useUpdateStatus, useAssignMechanic, useAddPart, useRemovePart) that call the services layer and wire success/error toasts and query invalidation. Logic lives here, not in components (FE3).
Add minimal Vitest unit tests covering the pure-logic units: api-client envelope unwrap + error throwing, the ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS helper, and the role-guard redirect decision.
acceptance_criteria: cd c:/Users/Acer/Documents/ANTIGRAV/bengkel-motor-6/frontend && pnpm install && pnpm run build completes with no errors.
pnpm run test passes (api-client, transitions, role-guard unit tests green).
git check-ignore frontend/.env.local prints the path (env stays untracked); frontend/.env.example IS tracked.
types/api.ts ServiceStatus and ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS match backend/src/constants/index.ts exactly, including Dibatalkan.
No component contains data-fetching or business logic directly; it lives in hooks/services (FE3).
verification: cd c:/Users/Acer/Documents/ANTIGRAV/bengkel-motor-6/frontend && pnpm install && pnpm run build
cd c:/Users/Acer/Documents/ANTIGRAV/bengkel-motor-6/frontend && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
findings:
Foundation complete at frontend/. Verification (same commit): `pnpm install && pnpm run build` OK (Next 16.4.3 + Turbopack, TypeScript passed, prerendered / and /_not-found). `pnpm run lint` clean. `pnpm run test` = 17 tests / 3 files green (api-client envelope unwrap+error, ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS helper, role-guard decision). `git check-ignore frontend/.env.local` prints the path; frontend/.env.example is NOT ignored (trackable).

STACK (resolved versions, cutting-edge): Next 16.4.3 (App Router, src-dir, @/* alias), React 19.3.0, Tailwind v4 (CSS-first via @import 'tailwindcss' in src/app/globals.css; NO tailwind.config.js), TypeScript 5.9, shadcn/ui new-york style (components.json present), react-hook-form 7.91, zod 4.6.7, @tanstack/react-query 5.105, axios ~1.21 (registry's current 1.x), lucide-react, sonner 2.0.8. Testing: vitest 5 + @testing-library/react 16 + jsdom (vitest.config.ts with @ alias + jsdom + vitest.setup.ts). Scripts: build, lint ('eslint .'), test ('vitest run'). NOTE: next.config.ts has turbopack CSS rule and I REMOVED the scaffold's experimental `cacheComponents`/`partialPrefetching` to keep the provider-wrapped client app buildable — do not re-add without need.

ZOD v4 is installed (not v3): use z.enum/z.object v4 API. ESLint note: Next 16's react-hooks plugin forbids synchronous setState inside useEffect bodies (rule react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) and forbids unescaped entities; auth-context hydrates via lazy useState initializers + an awaited microtask. Keep this pattern in new client components.

KEY EXPORTS FOR FEAT-002..005:
- Types: @/types/api -> ApiEnvelope<T>, ApiErrorEnvelope, ApiFieldError, PaginationMeta, User, Mechanic, Booking, PartUsedItem, StatusHistoryEntry, Part (isLowStock?), Service, DashboardReport, RevenueReport, AuthResult, UserRole, ServiceStatus, BookingType, PopulatedRef<T>. Constants: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS (mirrors backend incl. Dibatalkan), SERVICE_STATUS_FLOW (5 stages). Booking.mechanicId/customerId/serviceId are PopulatedRef (string | object) — narrow before use.
- API layer: @/lib/api-client -> apiClient, request<T>, requestPaginated<T> ({data,pagination}), requestBlob (PDF), ApiRequestError (.status,.fieldErrors,.message), API_BASE_URL. 401 auto-clears session.
- Services (pure, @/services/*): auth{register,login,me,updateMe,changePassword}, users{createStaff,mechanics,list,getById,toggleStatus}, bookings{createOnline,createWalkIn,list,getById,assign,updateStatus,addPart,removePart,invoicePdfBlob}, parts{list,lowStock,getById,create,update}, services{list,getById,create,update,remove}, reports{dashboard,revenue}. CONTRACT GOTCHAS matched to backend: changePassword uses {oldPassword,newPassword}; toggleStatus PATCH /users/:id/status {isActive}; services GET is public; parts GET requires auth; list query params include includeInactive(bool), status, bookingType, plateNumber, mechanicId, startDate, endDate, page, limit.
- Auth/session: @/lib/session (localStorage keys motorcenter.token / motorcenter.user, subscribe()), @/lib/auth-context (AuthProvider), @/hooks/use-auth (useAuth -> {user,token,isAuthenticated,isHydrated,login,logout,refresh,setUser}).
- Roles/routing: @/lib/roles -> ROLE_HOME, AREA_ROLES, homeForRole, allowedAreas, isRoleAllowed. admin home = /staff and admin may ALSO enter /owner. Areas: pelanggan->/pelanggan, kasir&admin->/staff, mekanik->/mekanik, pemilik&admin->/owner. Guard decision: @/lib/guard-decision (decideGuard, pure). Component: @/components/guards/role-guard (RoleGuard allowedRoles).
- Status helpers: @/lib/transitions -> canTransition, nextStatuses, isTerminalStatus.
- Formatters: @/lib/format -> formatRupiah, formatDate, formatDateTime (Intl id-ID, Asia/Jakarta).
- React Query hooks: @/hooks/use-queries -> useBookings, useBooking, useParts, useServices, useMechanics, useUsers, useDashboard, useRevenue (all accept (query, enabled?)). Mutations @/hooks/use-mutations -> useLogin, useRegister, useCreateBooking ({type:'online'|'walk-in', data}), useUpdateStatus ({id,data}), useAssignMechanic ({id,mechanicId}), useAddPart ({id,data}), useRemovePart ({id,partItemId}). Query keys: @/hooks/query-keys. Hooks own toasts+invalidation (invalidate ['bookings'] and ['parts']); components stay presentation-only (FE3).
- Providers: @/components/providers (QueryClientProvider+AuthProvider) already wraps app in src/app/layout.tsx; <Toaster> (sonner) mounted there too — do NOT double-wrap.
- UI primitives in @/components/ui: button,input,label,form,select,dialog,table,card,badge,sonner,dropdown-menu,skeleton,tabs. Presentational components in @/components: StatusBadge, StatusStepper (5-stage + Dibatalkan), DataTable (generic columns/rows/getRowId), PageHeader, StatCard, EmptyState, LoadingState/TableSkeleton, ErrorState, ConfirmDialog, FormField (RHF wrapper). cn() in @/lib/utils.

ROUTES NOT YET CREATED (owned by later FEATs): /login, /register, /pelanggan, /staff, /mekanik, /owner. The RoleGuard and ROLE_HOME already point at them. src/app currently has only / (landing with link to /login) and the root layout.
